verses.text: Ab'ek wal juntzanh tik ex sacerdote. Maklejek eyab' ex chonhab' Israel. Ab'ek pax ex yinhtilal ex heb' rey: Ha t'a eyib'anh a ex tik ol och jun ya'elal tik, yujto a ex tik, icha junok ch'anh ya'al heyaj t'a Mizpa yet' t'a jolom witz Tabor.
Tzijtum anima ix he mak'cham yuj he pitalil, yuj chi' ol wak'och ya'elal t'a eyib'anh.
Ex israel ayex t'a yol yik Efraín, wojtak tas eyaji. ¿Tom tze na'a to manh wojtakok tas heyaj chi'? Ix eyak'och he b'a ajmulal, ix eyixtejel he b'a t'a yajb'entakil.
Yuj he chuk b'eyb'al chi', max yal he meltzajkot t'ayin. Anhej t'a juntzanh komon Dios tzeyal he b'a. Yuj wal to he gana he k'ulan ajmulal, yuj chi' maxtzak in he na jab'ok.
Ex aj Efraín, a eyik'ojchanhb'ail sch'oxanel he chukalil. Ex aj Israel, munil ol ex telwok yuj eyajmulal chi'. Yet' ex aj Judá lajan ol aj he telwi yet' heb'.
Ol b'at in he sayek'i, eyet'nak nok' he kalnel yet' nok' he wakax yik tzeyak' silab'il t'ayin. Palta manhxo ol in ilchajlaj eyu'uj, yujto toxo ix wik'el in b'a t'a he kal.
Yujto te chuk ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin, ay eyuninal mitz' unin yaji. Yuj chi' ha t'a k'inh ayik tz'alji k'e'en uj, hata' ol ex satel yet' he munlajel.
Puchajokab' nok' ch'a'ak yik owal t'a Gabaa, puchajokab'pax k'e'en trompeta t'a Ramá. Awajanhek t'a Bet-awén. Ayokab' xiwk'olal t'a skal heb' anima yik Benjamín.
Ha in swal t'a skal masanil heb' yinhtil Israel yuj tas yowalil ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb': Ha heb' aj Efraín, ol lajwokel heb' yuj ya'elal ol jawok t'a jun k'uhal chi'.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Ha heb' yajal t'a Judá, lajan heb' icha juntzanh anima tz'ik'ancha'anh tz'aka'anh, yuj chi' ol in satel heb' yet' yowal in k'o'ol.
Ha chonhab' Efraín tik, toxo ix ja t'a yib'anh. Manhxalaj tas ay t'ay, yujto ix yak'och t'a sk'ol yoch tzak'an yuj juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha in ol wixtejb'at chonhab' Efraín icha tz'aj yixtax junok tas yuj nok' ha'ay. Ol wixtanb'at chonhab' Judá icha tz'aj sk'ab'at junok tas.

Ayik ix yilan chonhab' Efraín to ya ay, ix yilanpax yechen Judá, ix b'at chonhab' Efraín chi' t'a Asiria sk'an skolwal jun rey b'inajnak yak'an owal, palta maj yal-laj yuj jun rey chi' yak'an b'oxok sk'o'ol, maj yalpaxlaj yanhtan yechen chi'.

Icha wal tz'aj smakwaj junok nok' choj, icha chi' ol aj in makwaj t'a chonhab' Efraín yet' t'a chonhab' Judá. Ha in ol in chok' tzilejb'at heb', ol waktankan heb' b'i'an, haxo in b'at chi'. Ol in tzak'cha'anh heb', manhxa mach ol yal skolan heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Haxo in meltzaj chi' t'a elanhchamel b'aj kajan in masanto ol yojtakejel smul heb', haxo sjawi heb' chi' yal sb'a t'ayin. Ha t'a skal sya'elal heb' chi', ol yal sb'a heb' t'ayin t'a smasanil sk'o'ol.
